baselineVersion: 0.4.6 plus the separately proven inline-dash change
policy: All candidates use the same original input, frozen scan pose, panel bounds and non-text pixels. Proportions were selected on development names; replay examples have been inspected before and are not independent validation. No per-card production adjustments. Font-width trials that scale the entire line also stretch inline symbols; the letter-only variant preserves their size/aspect/advance. The stable-class variant additionally keeps the natural-width nominal size class, preventing minor proportion changes from switching to a much smaller font.

selection.policy: Before inspecting new validation results, treat development means within 0.001 as equivalent; prefer fewer regressions over 0.05, then less horizontal scaling, then regular size closest to 22.5. All choices use development rows only. This is a deterministic tie policy, not a statistical confidence bound.

limitations: Candelabra of Tawnos has a scan-reviewed missing colon in the original source; correct the input and replay before final adoption.
Residual transcription, font weight and verse wrapping need review. These are regional overlap indices, not complete-card accuracy.
Only private candidate painters implement these shared profiles. Native integration, full 316-card replay, scope checks and release remain open.
